Welcome To Shawnee Grain & Feed

At Shawnee Milling Company, we take great pride in producing some of the finest animal feeds in the industry. Formulated by a team of specialized animal nutritionists, our products are designed to maximize the performance and health of your animal. Once you try our products, we believe you will agree:

"The Quality of Our Products is Second to None."
